name: Hesperian Health Guides
typical_licence: Hesperian Open Copyright Policy (non-commercial copy/adapt with credit; permission needed for any digital format)
rationale: Publisher of Where There Is No Doctor, the standard community health manual since 1977; regularly revised (22nd printing March 2025)
notes: Copyright page asks for permission before distributing in any digital format: owner to email permissions@hesperian.org before mirroring copies. Chapter PDFs are at hesperian.org/wp-content/uploads/pdf/en_wtnd_2025/; file names change between printings. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: World Health Organization
rationale: Global public-health authority; peer-reviewed technical guidance
notes: PDFs on iris.who.int; HEAD requests fail there (HTTP 500) but GET works. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: International Committee of the Red Cross
typical_licence: Varies; co-published WHO items carry the WHO licence
rationale: Field medicine, war surgery and first aid in low-resource settings
notes: Co-publisher of WHO-ICRC Basic Emergency Care. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
rationale: Sets the international first-aid guidelines used by 190+ national Red Cross/Red Crescent societies
notes: ifrc.org is behind a Cloudflare browser check: automated download fails; download manually in a browser. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Canadian Red Cross Society
typical_licence: © Canadian Red Cross Society; all rights reserved (reproduction needs written permission)
rationale: National society of the IFRC (approved); its lay first-aid programme follows the IFRC/ILCOR guidelines, with a medical director and a national medical advisory council. Written for a cold climate.
notes: PDFs on cdn.redcross.ca download normally with a browser user agent (20 Nov 2026). Licence is all rights reserved; owner assumes full permission (19 Nov 2026). Proposed 20 Nov 2026 for T1-014. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: US Army Publishing Directorate
typical_licence: Public release items: distribution unlimited (US government work)
rationale: Official field manuals; field-tested, plainly written, often illustrated
notes: Use only items marked 'Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited'. Check for superseded editions (e.g. TC 4-02.1 replaced by ATP 4-02.11 in March 2026). Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: US Navy, Naval Education and Training Command (Seabee nonresident training courses)
typical_licence: Distribution Statement A (public release); some covers add a 'copyrighted material' notice
rationale: Seabee rate training manuals: the standard plain-language trade courses for plumbing, wiring and welding, maintained by the Center for Seabees and Facilities Engineering
notes: Official copies on media.defense.gov (June 2014 batch, files 140620-N-ZZ182-NNNN). media.defense.gov refuses scripts (403): download in Chrome with the PDF viewer's download button, one file at a time. Some courses are split over several files without covers. Proposed 20 Nov 2026 for T2-125..127. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
typical_licence: US federal government work (generally public domain; confirm per item)
rationale: National public-health authority; clear public fact sheets
notes: cdc.gov returns HTTP 403 to curl: download script needs a browser user-agent or manual download. US measures (gallons/teaspoons) noted on items. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: WEDC, Loughborough University (for WHO)
rationale: Authors of the WHO Technical Notes on water and sanitation in emergencies
notes: Hosts the official WHO technical-notes PDFs. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Santé publique France
rationale: French national public-health agency; official prevention leaflets
notes: Some download links on the site are stale (return HTML instead of PDF): check content-type. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Service-Public.fr (Direction de l'information légale et administrative)
rationale: Official French government information site
notes: HTML pages: save as a self-contained snapshot.

name: Centres antipoison (French poison-control network)
rationale: Official list of the 24/7 French poison-control centres
notes: Coordinated nationally with ANSES. Numbers matched the European EAPCCT directory on 17 Nov 2026.

name: Médecins Sans Frontières
typical_licence: All rights reserved; free PDF download, reproduction needs prior permission
rationale: Clinical and essential-drug guidelines for low-resource settings
notes: Tier 2 health and water (T2-035 to T2-037). CLAUDE.md lists MSF guidelines as a trusted core source. Clinical guidelines are part of the WHO Emergency Health Kit. Owner to ask permission for private family copies, as for Hesperian. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: MDWiki / WikiMed (via Kiwix)
rationale: Medical encyclopedia curated by physicians; distributed as Kiwix ZIM
notes: Tier 2/3 ZIM. Listed as a trusted core source in CLAUDE.md (17 Nov 2026). Medical articles written and reviewed by physicians; packaged by openZIM as WikiMed. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: MedlinePlus (US National Library of Medicine)
rationale: Consumer health reference from the NLM
notes: Available as Kiwix ZIM. Listed as a trusted core source in CLAUDE.md (17 Nov 2026). US National Library of Medicine; public domain consumer health content. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Croix-Rouge française
rationale: French first-aid training body (PSC1)
notes: No official public 'gestes qui sauvent' PDF found. French first-aid content is now sourced from DGSCGC PSC1/GQS (the national reference that Croix-Rouge training follows).

name: Fédération Française de Cardiologie
rationale: Publishes a public 'gestes qui sauvent' (alerter-masser-défibriller) brochure
notes: Checked 17 Nov 2026: the 'Arrêt cardiaque 1 vie = 3 gestes' pocket card (09/2021) lists only call/massage/defibrillate with no how-to, and the 2021 GQS brochure is advocacy, not instructions. Not used; DGSCGC PSC1/GQS cover this.

name: European Resuscitation Council / Resuscitation Council UK
typical_licence: All rights reserved; reproduction by permission
rationale: Authoritative 2025 resuscitation and first-aid guidelines
notes: Free web text but reuse needs permission; RCUK 'View PDF' is a print of the web page. Include only with written permission. 19 Nov 2026: owner assumes full permission, so no longer excluded; candidate source for an English CPR sheet (Tier 1 gap).

name: Kiwix
rationale: De facto standard for offline web content (ZIM)
notes: openZIM is the Kiwix team that packages most ZIMs; its packaging is trusted, but each ZIM is judged by its content source (the publisher column in catalog.csv). Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Kiwix Community Library
rationale: Contains useful items (e.g. The Last Codex) but is unvetted
notes: Every item needs an individual review row.

name: iFixit
rationale: Large library of illustrated repair guides
notes: Tier 2 (repair) via Kiwix ZIM. Listed as a trusted core source in CLAUDE.md (17 Nov 2026). Guides are community-written but moderated, with step photos; CC BY-NC-SA. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Project Gutenberg
rationale: Long-running, curated public-domain library
notes: Tier 3 books. Listed as a trusted core source in CLAUDE.md (17 Nov 2026). Public-domain books, proofread by volunteers. Old books can be out of date, so practical and medical titles still need a look before anyone relies on them. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Santé.fr (Ministère chargé de la santé)
rationale: Official public-health information portal of the French health ministry
notes: HTML articles: save as self-contained snapshots.

name: Ministère de l'Intérieur — Direction générale de la Sécurité civile et de la gestion des crises (DGSCGC)
rationale: Issues the official French first-aid recommendations (PSC1, GQS, PSE) that all French first-aid training follows
notes: interieur.gouv.fr blocks scripts (HTTP 403): download by hand in a browser.

name: Wikimedia projects (Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiversity, Wikisource, Wikivoyage)
rationale: The standard open reference works; packaged and updated monthly by openZIM
notes: Openly edited: good general reference, not authoritative for medicine (use WikiMed/MedlinePlus/Hesperian). Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: NHS (UK National Health Service)
rationale: UK national health service; plain-language medicines guide
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: US Department of Defense medical manuals (hosted by Federation of American Scientists)
rationale: Official military medical manuals collected by FAS
notes: Several manuals are old (1980s-2000s). Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: FEMA / Ready.gov
rationale: Official US disaster-preparedness guidance
notes: US-centric. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: US Department of Agriculture
rationale: Research-based home food preservation (USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning)
notes: Also the Forest Service Forest Products Laboratory (Wood Handbook, T2-103). Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Agromisa Foundation (with CTA), Agrodok series
rationale: Wageningen-based foundation; Agrodok booklets were practical, illustrated farming manuals co-published with CTA (EU-ACP agency) from 1980s to 2010s
notes: Agromisa office closed 2021; CTA closed 2020. CGSpace hosts the CTA archive open access. Most titles assume a tropical climate: pick only climate-neutral ones. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Virginia Cooperative Extension (Virginia Tech and Virginia State University)
rationale: Land-grant university extension: research-based home gardening guidance, revised since 1985; used to train Master Gardeners
notes: Fills the temperate food-growing gap that Agrodok and FAO (tropical) leave open. US pesticide rules differ from the EU. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Appropedia Foundation
rationale: Long-running appropriate-technology wiki with university contributors
notes: Openly edited: practical projects, review before relying on safety-critical designs. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: energypedia (founded by GIZ)
rationale: Renewable-energy knowledge base used by development practitioners
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: CD3WD Project (Compact Disc Third World Development)
rationale: Classic appropriate-technology library compiled from GTZ/GATE, FAO, ITDG/Practical Action, Peace Corps and others
notes: Mostly 1980s-2000s documents. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: WikiVet (consortium of UK veterinary schools)
rationale: Veterinary encyclopedia built by veterinary schools
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: CIA World Factbook
rationale: Standard country reference; 2020 final print edition
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: PhET Interactive Simulations (University of Colorado Boulder)
rationale: Widely used science and maths simulations for teaching
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: LibreTexts (UC Davis-led consortium)
rationale: Large open textbook library used by universities
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Khan Academy
rationale: Standard free course library for school maths and science
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Crash Course (Complexly / PBS Digital Studios)
rationale: Well-known educational video series
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: OpenStreetMap (maps packaged by openZIM)
rationale: The standard open world map
notes: Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Gardenology
rationale: Plant and garden encyclopedia
notes: Unknown editorial control: needs review.

name: Stack Exchange (community Q&A sites)
rationale: Practical answers (DIY, gardening, cooking, repair) not found elsewhere
notes: Not a vetted publisher; owner decision pending (see catalog README).

name: Survivor Library
rationale: Best-known preparedness archive
notes: Mostly scanned 1800s-1930s books; recommended reject.

name: Tony R. Kuphaldt, Lessons in Electric Circuits
rationale: Long-running free textbook series on electricity and electronics (since 2000, 5th edition), used in technical colleges and mirrored by All About Circuits
notes: Individual author, but the series has been openly reviewed and corrected for over 20 years. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: WikiCiv
rationale: Wiki manual for rebuilding technology from scratch
notes: Community content; authors unknown. Spot check before use.

name: Low-tech Magazine (Kris De Decker)
rationale: Well-researched articles on low-tech energy and historical technologies since 2007
notes: No licence stated on the site (checked 18 Nov 2026). 19 Nov 2026: owner assumes full permission; spot check before use (D9).

name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
typical_licence: Older: non-commercial reproduction authorised; 2011-2016: free upon request; since ~2017 mostly CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO
rationale: UN agency for food and agriculture; practical smallholder guides (Diversification booklets)
notes: openknowledge.fao.org refuses scripted access (403, 18 Nov 2026); PDFs on www.fao.org/4/ download normally. Owner to ask copyright@fao.org for the 2011 booklets. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: US Peace Corps, Information Collection & Exchange (ICE)
typical_licence: ICE manuals: reproduction and translation allowed without payment or royalty
rationale: Field-tested practical manuals for development workers: agriculture, appropriate technology, water, health
notes: Catalog pages refuse most scripted requests (only 2 of 7 pages read, 18 Nov 2026); files.peacecorps.gov serves the PDFs. Many manuals are from the 1980s. Signed off by owner 19 Nov 2026.

name: Natural Resources Canada (Office of Energy Efficiency)
rationale: Canada's federal energy department; its home energy guides are the standard Canadian retrofit references, written for homeowners and kept in print since the 1980s
notes: Proposed 20 Nov 2026 for T2-128 (Keeping the Heat In). PDFs on natural-resources.canada.ca download normally. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC)
typical_licence: © CMHC; all rights reserved (reproduction needs written permission)
rationale: Canada's national housing agency; publishes building-science guides for homeowners, often with NRCan
notes: Proposed 20 Nov 2026 for T2-129 (wood heating guide). publications.gc.ca shows an "archived" notice first: scripts get HTML, so download in a browser. Licence is all rights reserved; owner assumes full permission (19 Nov 2026). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Organic Seed Alliance
rationale: Non-profit doing participatory seed research and farmer training since 2003; its guides are written by seed breeders (Dr John Navazio) and widely used by seed libraries and extension services
notes: Proposed 20 Nov 2026 for T2-130. The 2026 revision of the seed-saving guide is a web page only; the publisher still hosts the 2010 PDF. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Book Dash
rationale: Registered South African non-profit (NPO, section 18A public benefit). Professional writers, illustrators and designers volunteer to make picture books, which are edited and published under CC BY 4.0 and given away in print to young children.
notes: Proposed 20 Nov 2026 for T3-056. Books are set in Southern Africa; written for read-aloud to children up to 8. 214 English titles on the live site in Nov 2026. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: National Bee Unit (Animal and Plant Health Agency, UK)
typical_licence: Crown copyright; may be reproduced free of charge if reproduced accurately and not in a misleading context
rationale: The UK government's bee health service (bee inspectors, diagnostic lab, varroa research). Its advisory leaflets are revised regularly and written for hobby beekeepers.
notes: Proposed 20 Nov 2026 for T2-133 and T2-134. Its "International beekeeping training manuals" (2011) were left out: written for African top-bar beekeeping (wrong climate, rule 8). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: B.C. Ministry of Agriculture and Food, with the B.C. Pork Producers Association
typical_licence: Reproduction for any purpose except resale, with acknowledgement (Small Lot Pork manual)
rationale: Provincial agriculture ministry. Its Small Lot Pork Producer manual was written under contract by a swine veterinary practice (Prairie Swine Health Services) for small and outdoor pig keepers.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-136. Use the copy linked from the government pork page (path with /small-lot-pork-manual/). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Christian Veterinary Mission
typical_licence: Free copying and adaptation with credit, distributed free or at cost
rationale: Veterinary NGO founded in 1976. Its Where There Is No Animal Doctor (2000, revised 2016) is the livestock counterpart of Hesperian's Where There Is No Doctor, written by two veterinarians for keepers with no vet.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-137. Faith-based organisation; the book itself is plain veterinary content. Server at cvm.org is slow. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Teagasc (Agriculture and Food Development Authority, Ireland)
rationale: Ireland's state agricultural research, advisory and training body. Its Beef Manual (2016) is the standard Irish farmer's reference; Ireland's grass-based cattle farming is the closest climate match to northern France among English sources.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-138..140 (3 of the 8 Beef Manual sections). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Humane Slaughter Association
rationale: UK charity founded in 1911, the reference body for humane slaughter and on-farm killing; its guides are written with the British Cattle Veterinary Association and the Sheep Veterinary Society.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-141. hsa.org.uk blocks scripts (Cloudflare 403): fetch in Chrome. Its Technical Note 8, On-farm slaughter of livestock for consumption, is the wanted next item. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: University of New Hampshire Cooperative Extension
rationale: Land-grant university extension service, like Virginia Cooperative Extension (vce). Its 4-H Working Steer manual was written with Drew Conroy, the leading US author on working oxen.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-142. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Core Knowledge Foundation
rationale: US non-profit founded by E. D. Hirsch. Its Core Knowledge Language Arts (CKLA) programme is a full systematic-phonics curriculum used in US public schools; the K-2 Skills Strand readers are fully decodable and given away under CC BY-NC-SA.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T3-058..069 (12 CKLA Skills Strand readers, Kindergarten Units 6-10 and Grade 1 Units 1-7). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Department for Education (UK; formerly DfES)
typical_licence: Crown copyright; newer publications under the Open Government Licence
rationale: England's education ministry. Letters and Sounds (2007) was the national phonics programme for English primary schools for over a decade.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T3-057 (Letters and Sounds, 2007). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Arctic Renewables Society (with Relay Education)
rationale: Nunavut non-profit (founded 2019) that trains residents to install small renewable systems. Its 2025 cabin solar guide was written by Relay Education, a renewable-energy education charity, funded by the Government of Canada and published on the Government of Nunavut's climate-change site.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-143. Content spot-checked (fuses, cable sizes, batteries in the cold). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency (MCF; formerly MSB)
rationale: Sweden's national civil-protection agency; its brochure In case of crisis or war is sent to every household in Sweden on behalf of the government (5.2 million copies in 2024).
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-146. MSB was renamed MCF in 2026; the PDF still sits on rib.msb.se. Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Secrétariat général de la défense et de la sécurité nationale (SGDSN)
rationale: Publisher of France's official household preparedness guide, Tous responsables (Nov 2025).
notes: Deferred with the French content (English-only v1). Proposed 21 Nov 2026.

name: Kansas State University Research and Extension
typical_licence: Free publications; educational reproduction with credit
rationale: Land-grant university extension service (Agricultural Experiment Station and Cooperative Extension); its fact sheets are written by university specialists for farm families.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T2-148 (poultry processing). Signed off by owner 21 Nov 2026.

name: Mozilla Foundation and Mozilla Corporation
rationale: Maker of Firefox, one of the three major web browsers, open source since 1998; builds are signed and published with SHA256SUMS on archive.mozilla.org.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T9-006..008 (the drive's own browser).

name: SumatraPDF project (Krzysztof Kowalczyk)
rationale: Long-running (since 2006) free, open-source PDF reader for Windows, widely used and distributed as a portable zip by its author.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T9-009.

name: Artifex Software (MuPDF)
rationale: Developer of MuPDF and Ghostscript, PDF software used for decades; publishes MuPDF builds with SHA-256 checksums on mupdf.com.
notes: Proposed 21 Nov 2026 for T9-013 (Android PDF reader).
